llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: (1) It offers excessively discounted prices over a broad and unrelated product range. (2) The company details on the site (シスデザイン株式会社, Sysdesign Inc.) do not match the official/legitimate business and use an unrelated domain (nijqicwx.my) which is not referenced in legitimate contexts. (3) The contact email is with 'cmvfever.com', not a professional domain tied to the company, which is atypical for valid e-commerce operations. (4) The company address is likely fabricated and merely copied; no verifiable business trace exists for 'zoyl.nijqicwx.my'. (5) The site employs urgency and psychological tactics ('14日間まで返品OK', 'お得に買える'), but lacks trusted payment/withdrawal descriptions or professional payment methods. All these factors strongly indicate a fake online shopping scam, spoofing a legitimate brand to deceive consumers.
